description: 경기도_역사내 승강기 현황 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내 철도 역사 내에 설치된 승강기의 현황을 기록한 자료로, 각 역사별 승강기의 위치, 출입구 번호, 시작 및 종료 운행층수, 정원수 및 무게, 승강기 번호, 철도운영기관명. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 경기도, 지하철역, 승강기, 역사내승강기, 역명. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
